::: {#rem-maximum-likelihood-kl-divergence-loss}
#### One labeled example

For a single labeled example, $n = 1$,
and the [empirical distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/nonparametric-models.html#def-empirical-distribution) puts all its mass on the observed label.
Then @thm-maximum-likelihood-kl-divergence says that the model with the largest [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) for that label
is the model with the smallest divergence from it.
That is the case that [the cross-entropy loss remark](source-coding.qmd#rem-cross-entropy-loss) describes.

:::
